home.faqQ1: Do I need a CV to use Pracuj.be?
home.faqA1: No. Instead of a CV, you fill in a short profile with your experience and skills. Employers can see it and contact you directly.
home.faqQ2: Is Pracuj.be free for job seekers?
home.faqA2: Yes. Creating a profile, searching for jobs and applying are completely free for candidates.
home.faqQ3: What languages does the platform support?
home.faqA3: You can use Pracuj.be in Polish, Dutch, French and English. The text of a job offer is in the language the employer wrote it in.
home.faqQ4: Do I have to speak Dutch or French?
home.faqA4: Not always. Many employers accept candidates without local language skills. Use the filter to see jobs with no language requirement.
home.faqQ5: How do employers get in touch with me?
home.faqA5: After you apply or publish your profile, employers can message you directly on the platform to arrange the next steps.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Answers to the most common questions about how Pracuj.be works. If you can’t find an answer here, write to us through the contact form.

noCv.q: Do I need a CV to look for work?
noCv.a: No. After you <register>sign up</register>, you create a simple professional profile in six short steps — including occupations, skills, languages and availability. You can add a CV file (PDF, DOC or DOCX up to 5 MB), but it is not required.

guestApply.q: Can I apply without creating an account?
guestApply.a: Yes. In the application form you enter your full name and email address, then confirm the application with the link in the email. Later you can create an account with the same address and take over the application.

match.q: How is the match with a job calculated?
match.a: The match percentage is based on fixed criteria: occupation and category, skills, location, experience, availability, languages, certificates, driving licence and contract terms. The result is not decided by artificial intelligence, and the job page shows what you meet and what is missing.

visibility.a: Verified companies can only find your profile if you turn on “Let verified employers find my profile” in your settings — it is off by default. A company you apply to sees your application. You can block specific companies in the “Blocked companies” section.

alerts.q: How do I get alerts about new jobs?
alerts.a: On the <jobs>job list</jobs>, set your filters and choose “Save search”. In the candidate panel you turn on email alerts for it — daily or weekly.

data.q: How do I download my data or delete my account?
data.a: In the candidate panel settings, in the “Your data and account” section, you can download your data as a JSON file or delete your account.

free.q: How much does it cost to publish jobs?
free.a: At this stage Pracuj.be is free for employers. The portal does not sell packages or paid job postings.

verification.q: Why does my company need to be verified?
verification.a: Only companies verified by a portal administrator can publish jobs. You see the verification status in the employer panel. If the company is rejected, you see the reason and can choose “Send for verification again”.

drafts.q: Can I prepare a job before verification?
drafts.a: Yes. The job wizard saves a draft after each step. You publish it once your company is verified.

team.a: The company owner or admin invites team members by email address in the employer panel and gives them a role.

applications.a: You handle applications, messages and job offers in the employer panel. Read more on the <employer>For employers</employer> page.

languages.q: Which languages is the site available in?
languages.a: The site is available in Polish, Dutch, French and English. You can change the language in the header or the footer.

emailLanguage.q: In which language will I receive emails?
emailLanguage.a: Emails about your account are sent in the language set on your account — even when the message comes from an employer who uses a different language.

noEmail.q: I am not receiving emails from the site. What should I do?
noEmail.a: Check your spam folder and that your email address is correct. If the message still doesn’t arrive, write to us through the contact form.

suspicious.q: A job looks suspicious. What should I do?
suspicious.a: On the job page, choose “Report this job” or “Report this company”. You can send a report without an account and you get a case number to check its status.
